observed: uploadFile selected result.pdf, but browser fetch(File) failed net::ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND with zero body bytes.
workaround: Assigned exact retained PDF bytes to File/DataTransfer on real file input and dispatched change; all submit/confirmation actions used real UI.
initial_pdf_failure: Strict CropBox/MediaBox equality rejected fractional float rounding in retained PDF; changed equality to 0.001 point tolerance and added fractional whitespace coverage.
